key_insight: Carrier Dynamics by Pockels Imaging (CDPI) directly maps charge-carrier motion inside operative semiconductor devices by imaging local electric-field changes in real space and time.
engineering_relevance: This gives device engineers a non-invasive way to link internal carrier transport with measurable current, improving diagnosis and design of solar cells and other optoelectronic devices.
method: Probe the local electric field using the Pockels effect
Image photogenerated electron clouds in real space
Correlate carrier evolution with conduction and displacement currents
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstration in CdTe radiation detectors with micrometre-scale spatial resolution and nanosecond temporal resolution.
watch_item: CDPI requires an appreciable electro-optic response, so its practicality may be limited in materials or device stacks with weak Pockels sensitivity or challenging optical access.
paper_title: Direct Spatiotemporal Imaging of Charge Carrier Dynamics in Operative Semiconductor Devices
